_about: Advanced combat techniques. 'inputs' says what the AI must be able to do; 'ticks' how fast. Techniques depend on version and server rules: 'check' marks ones to verify in the Training Grounds on the running version before relying on them.

w_tap.how: Release and re-press forward (or tap back) right after a hit so the next hit is a sprint hit with extra knockback.

strafing.how: Move sideways around the opponent while aiming, making their aim harder and dodging sweeps and arrows.

crit_spacing.how: Jump and time hits on the way down for x1.5; space hits to the weapon's cooldown.

shield_disable.how: Switch to an axe, hit the shielding opponent to disable their shield for 5 s, switch back to the main weapon.

stun_slam.how: Disable the shield with an axe and smash with the mace right after, so the slam can't be blocked.

attribute_swap.how: Hit, then switch hotbar slot in the same tick so another item's attributes or enchantments affect the hit (e.g. a mace's or sword's bonus with another item's enchantment). Behaviour depends on version and server.

hotbar_layout.how: Keep the main weapon, axe, pearls, healing, blocks and totems on fixed slots (number keys) so swaps are instant; the offhand holds a totem or shield.

crossbow_inventory_reload.how: Charge one crossbow, then in the inventory swap uncharged crossbows into the charging slot so several get loaded at once; fire them back to back.
crossbow_inventory_reload.ticks: several actions within a tick or two

totem_reequip.how: After a totem pops, put a new one in the offhand at once (swap-hands key, or from the inventory) before the next hit lands.

pearl_escape.how: Throw a pearl away (or up) to break a combo, escape a trap, or reach high ground; account for the 5 damage.

water_clutch.how: While falling, look down and place water just before landing to cancel fall damage, then pick it back up.

rod_combo.how: Hook the opponent with a fishing rod to interrupt their sprint or start a combo, then switch to the sword.

crystal_sequence.how: Place obsidian, place a crystal on it and hit it as the opponent gets close; repeat fast. Blast Protection and distance reduce the damage taken yourself.

anchor_sequence.how: Place a respawn anchor, charge it with glowstone and use it near the opponent (outside the Nether) to explode it.

block_clutch.how: Place blocks under yourself while bridging or falling (sneak at edges), or tower up to escape melee.
